title: Technical Project Manager
description:
### **Job Title**

Technical Project Manager

### **Job Description**

TPM role involves driving cross-functional teams to execute product updates, cost optimizations, compliance changes, and technology refreshes throughout the product lifecycle. The candidate will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering projects on time, within budget, and in alignment with business and regulatory requirements. This position requires strong technical understanding, stakeholder management, and project governance skills to ensure product continuity and sustained customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage end-to-end lifecycle management projects for personal health products, including cost reduction, component changes, quality improvements, and regulatory updates.
* Collaborate with R&D, Quality, Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Regulatory Affairs to ensure smooth execution of LCM initiatives.
* Drive project planning, including defining scope, timelines, deliverables, risk assessment, and resource allocation.
* Ensure compliance with medical device/healthcare product regulatory standards and internal quality management systems.
* Act as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, progress tracking, and timely decision-making.
* Monitor and report project performance through established KPIs and governance frameworks.
* Identify risks, develop mitigation strategies, and escalate issues proactively.
* Support business continuity by ensuring supply stability and seamless product transitions across geographies.
* Contribute to process improvements in project execution and lifecycle management frameworks.
* Monitors project activities closely, balancing risk-taking with issue escalation, and preparing detailed progress and escalation reports for the project steering team to ensure informed decision-making.
* Ensures that Philips standards (Process/Systems/Way-of-Working) are adopted and adhered to, as outlined in the Philips Business System (PBS) and the local Management System based on the Philips Excellence Process Framework (PEPF).
* Applies Philips PM Standards (PMBok and SAFe) with a basic understanding and practical application, ensuring that project management practices are aligned with organizational expectations and industry best practices.

**Minimum Requirements**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (BE/BTech) in Electrical, Mechanical, or related technical field.

**Experience**

* 8–10 years of professional experience in project management within healthcare, medical devices, or consumer health products.
* Proven experience in lifecycle management, product engineering changes, or supplier-driven projects.

**Certification**

* PMP (Project Management Professional) or equivalent certification is highly preferable.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (BE/BTech). Advanced degree (M.Tech/MBA) is a plus.

**Skills**

* Strong knowledge of product lifecycle management (PLM) processes.
* Familiarity with medical device regulations (ISO 13485, FDA, MDR, etc.) and compliance frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with project planning tools (MS Project, Jira, or similar).
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with experience in risk management and cost optimization projects.
* Ability to manage global, cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Knowledge of supply chain processes and supplier quality management is an advantage.

**How we work together**  
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.
  
Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.
  
Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
  
  
**About Philips**  
We are a health technology company. We built our entire company around the belief that every human matters, and we won't stop until everybody everywhere has access to the quality healthcare that we all deserve. Do the work of your life to help the lives of others.
  

* Learn more about our business .
* Discover our rich and exciting history .
* Learn more about our purpose .

If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care here .

title: Project Manager
description:
Job Function: Services The role:

What excites you about helping organizations transform their business through innovative AI and cloud solutions?

Do you thrive on translating complex business challenges into practical Generative AI solutions?

Are you ready to help customers move from AI ideas and pilots to scalable solutions that deliver measurable business value?

At SoftwareOne, we help organizations unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI through innovative technology solutions and expert consulting. We are looking for an AI Solutions Architect – Generative AI to work closely with customers, Sales, and Delivery teams to identify high-value use cases, design scalable AI solutions, and accelerate successful adoption.

As an AI Solutions Architect, you will combine strong technical expertise with business acumen to help customers realize value from Generative AI. You will lead customer discovery, shape solution architectures, support presales engagements, and provide technical guidance throughout implementation. You will translate business challenges into practical AI use cases, develop compelling value propositions, and help customers move from initial concepts and proofs of concept to secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Leading customer discovery sessions to understand business objectives, pain points, existing environments, and potential Generative AI use cases.
* Designing secure and scalable AI solutions across areas such as content generation, intelligent customer service, knowledge management, data analysis, and workflow automation.
* Supporting presales engagements through technical presentations, demonstrations, workshops, proof-of-concepts, proposals, and solution documentation.
* Developing business cases and value hypotheses that demonstrate how AI can improve efficiency, reduce costs, manage risk, or create new revenue opportunities.
* Collaborating with Sales and Delivery teams to ensure solutions are technically feasible, commercially viable, and successfully transitioned into implementation.
* Monitoring AI market developments and customer trends while identifying opportunities for service expansion, innovation, and continuous improvement.

What we need to see from you:

* Experience in AI solution architecture, technical presales, solution consulting, or customer-facing Data & AI roles.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, large language models, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, and enterprise AI solution patterns.
* Familiarity with platforms and frameworks such as Azure OpenAI, Microsoft AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI, Hugging Face, or LangChain.
* Ability to translate customer business challenges into practical AI solutions, measurable outcomes, and compelling business-value narratives.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills in Chinese and English, with confidence engaging executives, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
* Strong collaboration and delivery mindset, with the ability to coordinate across Sales, architecture, engineering, and project teams.

Why SoftwareOne?:

SoftwareOne is a global software and cloud solutions provider and distributor, powered by around 12,000 people across more than 70 countries. But what really makes us SoftwareOne is our people: curious minds, different perspectives, and talented teams working together to solve real challenges and create meaningful impact. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to grow, explore new possibilities, and build a career that’s uniquely yours, while helping shape what’s next in technology.

title: Required Assistant Project Manager for Civil Construction
description:
Armee Enterprises are looking for a responsible, proactive, and well-organized Assistant Project Manager to support the Project Manager in managing day-to-day civil construction activities. The candidate will be responsible for attending project meetings on behalf of the Project Manager when required, coordinating with contractors and site teams, monitoring construction progress, and providing accurate and timely updates to the Project Manager.

The ideal candidate should have good communication skills, technical knowledge of civil construction, and the ability to independently handle coordination and reporting responsibilities in the Project Manager's absence.

**2. Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**A. Project Meetings and Representation**

* Attend project meetings on behalf of the Project Manager whenever required.
* Represent the project team professionally during meetings with clients, architects, consultants, contractors, and vendors.
* Record meeting minutes, important discussions, decisions, pending issues, and action items.
* Communicate meeting outcomes and commitments to the Project Manager promptly.
* Follow up with concerned parties to ensure that agreed actions are completed on time.

**B. Site Supervision and Progress Monitoring**

* Monitor daily civil construction activities and site progress.
* Coordinate with site engineers, supervisors, contractors, and subcontractors.
* Track project timelines, milestones, and work schedules.
* Identify delays, execution issues, material shortages, and other potential risks.
* Ensure work is carried out according to approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
* Escalate major technical issues and deviations to the Project Manager.

**C. Reporting and Updates**

* Provide daily and weekly progress reports to the Project Manager.
* Share updates on work completed, work in progress, manpower deployment, material availability, and pending activities.
* Maintain records of site photographs, progress reports, meeting minutes, and project documentation.
* Immediately report critical delays, safety concerns, quality issues, and other urgent matters.
* Ensure the Project Manager remains informed about all important project developments during their absence.

**D. Contractor and Vendor Coordination**

* Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, consultants, and other project stakeholders.
* Follow up on material deliveries, labour availability, and pending work.
* Monitor contractor commitments and ensure timely completion of assigned activities.
* Assist in resolving routine coordination issues at the site.

**E. Drawing, Quality and Documentation**

* Review and coordinate the circulation of approved drawings and revisions with the site team.
* Assist in monitoring construction quality and compliance with project specifications.
* Maintain inspection records, checklists, site instructions, and other relevant documentation.
* Coordinate with the technical team to resolve drawing discrepancies and execution-related queries.

**F. Planning and Execution Support**

description:
**Company presentation**  

thyssenkrupp nucera offers world-leading technologies for high-efficiency electrolysis plants. The company has extensive in-depth knowledge in the engineering, procurement, and construction of electrochemical plants and a strong track record of more than 600 projects with a total rating of over 10 gigawatts already successfully installed. With its water electrolysis technology to produce green hydrogen, the company offers an innovative solution on an industrial scale for green value chains and an industry fueled by clean energy a major step towards a climate-neutrality. thyssenkrupp nucera successfully made an IPO in July and is a member of the SDAX of the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since September 2023.

www.thyssenkrupp-nucera.com

  
**Your responsibilities**

We are looking for an experienced **Senior Project Scheduler / Project Planning Engineer** to support the planning, monitoring, and control of a complex EPC / industrial project. The role is responsible for developing and maintaining integrated project schedules, coordinating interfaces across disciplines and partners, and providing reliable schedule analysis to support project decision-making.

The position requires strong planning expertise, confident stakeholder coordination, and excellent English communication skills for working with international project teams, clients, consortium partners, contractors, and suppliers.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop, maintain, and control integrated project schedules covering engineering, procurement, fabrication, manufacturing, logistics, erection, commissioning, and related project activities.
* Review contractual and execution requirements, including milestones, assumptions, constraints, interfaces, planning obligations, approved baselines, and re-baselining processes.
* Coordinate with internal teams, consortium partners, vendors, subcontractors, and client representatives to collect progress data and maintain accurate schedule updates.
* Perform critical path, float, risk, delay impact, forecast, and what-if analyses to identify schedule deviations and support project decisions.
* Propose mitigation, acceleration, or recovery measures in coordination with project management.
* Prepare schedule and progress reporting, including schedule updates, milestone tracking, look-ahead schedules, variance analyses, S-curves, dashboards, forecasts, and management summaries.
* Support project controls, risk management, cost control, performance monitoring, change management, and contractual schedule reporting by providing reliable schedule input and impact assessments.

  
**Your profile**  

**Required Qualifications and Experience**
------------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
* Over ten years of experience in project planning, scheduling, and project controls, preferably in EPC, industrial, energy, hydrogen, oil & gas, petrochemical, power generation, or other capital-intensive projects.
* Hands-on experience with Primavera P6 is obligatory, additionally Microsoft Project would be beneficial.
* Strong understanding of project scheduling and project controls, including critical path methodology, baseline and schedule control, progress measurement, earned value management, schedule risk analysis, and recovery planning.
* Experience in forecasting, performance reporting, change management, contractual schedule reporting, and assessing schedule impacts, including Extension of Time (EoT) requirements arising from contractual or project-related changes.
* Proven experience coordinating schedules in consortium, joint venture, or multi-contractor EPC environments with complex interfaces between partners, contractors, suppliers, and client representatives.
* Experience preparing management reports, S-curves, milestone reports, look-ahead schedules, dashboards, forecasts, and executive progress summaries.

**Language and Communication Requirements**
-------------------------------------------

* Excellent written and spoken English is mandatory.
* Ability to prepare clear schedule reports, planning inputs, presentations, and management summaries in English.
* Ability to communicate confidently with international project teams, clients, consortium partners, contractors, and suppliers.
* Strong facilitation skills for planning meetings, schedule reviews, and guide peers and progress discussions across organizational and cultural interfaces.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in hydrogen, electrolysis, renewable energy, process plants, industrial manufacturing, or modular package delivery projects.
* Additional exposure to large-scale international EPC projects with complex partner and subcontractor interfaces would be advantageous.
* Hands-on involvement in delay analysis, claims support, or forensic schedule review would be an advantage.
* PMP®, PMI-SP®, or similar project management / scheduling certification would be an advantage.
* Familiarity with ERP systems such as SAP or Microsoft Dynamics would be beneficial.

**Personal Attributes**
-----------------------

* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and reliable in handling large volumes of project data.
* Strong stakeholder management skills across different management levels and ability to drive alignment without direct authority.
* Confident communicator who can challenge schedule inputs constructively.
* Able to work in a fast-paced project environment with multiple priorities and under pressure.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally when required and able to stay abroad for particular period as per project and company demands.

The company is committed to strengthening diversity and inclusion at the workplace. It strives to create an inclusive work environment where employees can develop to achieve their full potential and a culture that welcomes differences and creates a sense of belonging.

title: Staff Program Manager, FinOps and Procurement Operations
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

As a Staff Program Manager in Product Operations, you will run the financial operations that keep Teradata's product organization licensed, funded, and accountable for spend. You will own day-to-day execution across software purchasing, cloud FinOps, cross-charges, and budget tracking, and you will run the controls and reporting that leaders use to make spend decisions. Based in India, you will work closely with global Product, Engineering, Finance, and Procurement stakeholders.

* **Software purchasing and PO operations:** Own the end-to-end purchasing cycle for product software, tooling, and services, from usage analysis and vendor quotes through requisitions in Oracle Fusion, approval routing, contract signature, PO issuance, receipting, and invoice resolution.
* **Renewals and licensing:** Maintain the product software license and renewal register, surface renewals well before term end, and work with Procurement and system owners to confirm options, terms, and required license quantities.
* **FinOps and cloud-spend execution:** Track R&D cloud spend against budget across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, prepare recurring spend reporting, validate cloud provider invoices and marketplace offers, and coordinate savings plan and commitment purchases while monitoring realized savings.
* **Cloud cost optimization:** Coordinate cost optimization workstreams, including account decommissioning and transfers, tagging and cost allocation, and follow-through with product and engineering owners on savings actions.
* **Cross-charge and budget tracking:** Track cloud, tooling, and software budgets and outlooks, validate and reconcile monthly cross-charges and chargebacks between departments, and reconcile monthly against Finance records with clear variance explanations.
* **Planning cycles:** Support annual budgeting and quarterly outlooks by working with budget owners and Finance on spend assumptions, license requirements, and forecast changes.
* **Operational controls:** Run controls over purchasing and spend, including approval hierarchy checks, complete cost center and GL coding, confirmation of delivery before receipting, and audit-ready records.
* **Reporting and follow-through:** Produce recurring reports and dashboards for Product Operations and product leadership, and drive open actions, missing data, and blockers to closure.
* **AI and automation:** Apply foundational AI skills to automate routine reporting, reconciliation, and follow-up, and identify manual steps that should be simplified or retired rather than automated.

**Who You’ll Work With**

You will work as part of Teradata's Product Operations team, collaborating daily with:

* Finance partners on budgets, outlooks, cross-charges, and monthly reconciliation.
* Procurement on supplier engagement, contract renewals, purchase orders, and invoice resolution.
* Product and Engineering leaders, budget owners, and system owners on spend ownership, license requirements, and cost optimization actions.
* Cloud FinOps and cloud operations teams on spend data, tagging, cost allocation, and savings initiatives.
* Software vendors, resellers, and cloud service providers on quotes, order forms, and billing.
* US-based Product Operations leadership during a regular daily overlap with US business hours.

Collaborate with colleagues who share a commitment to leveraging AI responsibly, ensuring our people and customers benefit from the opportunities AI creates.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* 6+ years in procurement operations, software asset management, FinOps, or financial operations, including at least 3 years in enterprise software, cloud, or technology companies.
* Hands-on procure-to-pay experience in an ERP such as Oracle Fusion, including requisitions, approval workflows, purchase orders, receipts, and invoice matching.
* Working knowledge of public cloud billing and cost management on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including invoice validation, savings plans or commitments, and cost allocation.
* Demonstrated experience with budget and forecast tracking, variance analysis, and cross-charge or chargeback reconciliation with Finance.
* Advanced Excel skills and experience building recurring reports or dashboards in Power BI or similar tools.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to drive follow-up across functions and time zones and escalate issues early.
* Ability to work a schedule that provides a regular daily overlap with US business hours.
* Foundational AI skills and the ability to understand how AI can be applied to improve outcomes in your area of expertise.

**What You'll Bring**

* FinOps Certified Practitioner or a comparable certification.
* Experience supporting US-based stakeholders from India or another global location.
* Familiarity with software licensing models, renewal negotiations, and contract signature workflows such as DocuSign.
* Experience with Smartsheet, Jira, or similar work management tools.
* A controls mindset: you keep records complete, approvals documented and spend auditable.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; you keep spend data tidy and stakeholders informed.
* Ability to build trust quickly with budget owners, engineers, and Finance partners; seen as a reliable execution partner rather than process overhead.
* A passion for how AI can unlock potential to help our teams, our customers, and our communities achieve great things.

#LI-VB1

Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

title: Senior Security Project Manager
description:
**Overview**

The Security Project Manager leads the end-to-end delivery of complex information security initiatives, combining disciplined project management with sufficient technical security insight to challenge assumptions, manage dependencies and support informed decisions.

Reporting to the Head of Information Security Transformation, the role coordinates multidisciplinary teams, vendors and business stakeholders; maintains strong governance over scope, schedule, cost, risk and benefits; and facilitates the organisational change required for secure solutions to be adopted and sustained

  
  

**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**

Strategic Focus

* Lead security projects from initiation through delivery, transition and closure, establishing clear scope, objectives, milestones, dependencies, resources, budgets and measurable outcomes.
* Define and track delivery, adoption and risk-reduction measures to confirm intended benefits are realised.
* Build trusted relationships with sponsors, business owners, technology leaders, risk teams and operational stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones.
* Provide concise, evidence-based reporting on progress, cost, risk, decisions, benefits and matters requiring executive intervention.

Operational Management

* Develop and maintain delivery plans, governance forums, status reporting, decision logs and financial controls in accordance with enterprise project delivery standards.
* Facilitate technical workshops, design reviews, planning sessions and delivery stand-ups, translating complex security concepts into clear actions, decisions and stakeholder impacts.
* Work closely with security architects, engineers and technology teams to validate estimates, identify technical dependencies and ensure security requirements are incorporated into delivery plans and acceptance criteria.
* Manage vendors and delivery partners against agreed scope, milestones, quality, commercial commitments and remediation actions.
* Maintain budget forecasts, resource plans, procurement activities and project charging information, supporting accurate cost management and recovery.
* Coordinate testing, implementation, cutover, support arrangements, documentation, training and handover to operational owners.

People Leadership

* Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, vendors and business stakeholders, creating clarity on responsibilities, decisions and shared delivery outcomes.
* Assess stakeholder, process and technology impacts and develop proportionate change, communication, engagement and training plans.
* Facilitate adoption by engaging impacted teams early, addressing resistance, clarifying new responsibilities and tracking readiness and uptake.
* Recognise when specialist technical or risk advice is required and ensure the appropriate subject-matter experts are engaged at the right stage.

Governance & Risk

* Manage risks, issues, assumptions and dependencies, ensuring timely escalation, accountable ownership and transparent reporting to sponsors and governance forums.
* Control scope and change requests, balancing security outcomes, delivery constraints, cost, operational readiness and business priorities.
* Apply practical awareness of identity, cloud, data protection, network security, privileged access, security operations and regulatory controls to delivery planning and decision-making.
* Ensure go-live criteria, control evidence, residual risks and operational acceptance are documented and approved before closure.
* Capture lessons learned and improve security project templates, governance, reporting and delivery practices.

The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.

  
  

**Experience & Personal Attributes**

Experience

* Relevant tertiary qualification in technology, cybersecurity, business or project management, or equivalent professional experience.
* Minimum 8+ years of project delivery experience, including responsibility for complex cybersecurity, infrastructure, cloud, identity, data protection or technology transformation initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience managing scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, dependencies, vendors and benefits across multidisciplinary teams.
* Demonstrated experience planning and facilitating business change, stakeholder communications, training, operational readiness and adoption.
* Proficiency with project delivery and reporting tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, Microsoft Project, Excel, Confluence or equivalent platforms.
* Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or Agile delivery certification is preferred; change management certification such as Prosci is desirable.

Personal Attributes

* Strong facilitator who can create clarity, drive decisions and align technical and non-technical stakeholders around shared outcomes.
* Technically curious and able to ask informed questions, challenge constructively and translate security complexity into practical delivery implications.
* Highly organised, accountable and comfortable managing ambiguity, competing priorities and delivery pressure.
* Clear and concise communicator with sound judgement, strong commercial awareness and confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
* Collaborative and outcome-focused, with a commitment to sustainable change, effective governance and continuous improvement.

* **Interface Design:** Build and configure user-friendly HMI/SCADA screens (WinCC, FactoryTalk, etc.) to manage parameters, user access, and diagnostics.
* **Drive Systems:** Configure, tune, and troubleshoot Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs) and precision servo systems for motors, conveyors, and actuators.

**Project Management & Lifecycle Execution**

**Execution & Cost Management**

* Map out project schedules, track progress against timelines, and mitigate technical risks across multiple simultaneous projects.

**Testing, Commissioning, & Field Support**

* **FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing):** Prepare protocols, execute automation related I/O signal testing, and successfully close out punch points before machinery leaves the shop floor.
* **Breakdown Diagnostics:** Provide root-cause analysis and permanent fixes for critical field or shop-floor automation breakdowns.

**Documentation & Compliance**

* Maintain version control for PLC/HMI source code backups and drive parameters.

Automation DQ & URS Cross-Verification: Conduct and document Design Qualification (DQ) activities by cross-verifying machine automation design, control philosophy, PLC/HMI functionality, instrumentation, alarms, interlocks, data handling, and critical parameters against the approved customer URS and applicable compliance requirements. Identify gaps, deviations, and design risks, coordinate corrective actions with Design/Engineering/Quality teams, and ensure DQ documentation is complete and traceable before FAT/SAT and project handover.

* Apply Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) protocols, incorporate hardware safety interlocks, and follow standard PPE guidelines.

* On-time project completion within defined budgets and technical scopes.
* Swift closure of FAT punch points and successful first time-right SAT handovers.
* High quality of programming logic resulting in reduced machine downtime and cycle-time optimizations.

Project Engineer

The MEP Site Engineer is responsible for the planning, execution, supervision, coordination, and quality control of Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) works at the project site. * Supervise and monitor day-to-day MEP installation activities, ensuring execution aligns with approved drawings, specifications, and project requirements.

* Good understanding of MEP drawings, shop drawings, specifications, coordination drawings, and construction practices.

description:

The Project Manager will be responsible for delivering priority Value Creation Plan, Continuous Improvement and selected business transformation initiatives from initiation through to implementation and benefits realisation.

The role will provide additional delivery capacity to ensure that the organisation’s highest-value initiatives are properly planned, governed, resourced and executed. The Project Manager will work closely with Business Process Managers and functional project leads using the established BPM Engagement model to provide the structure, pace, coordination, challenge and visibility required to execute and maximise delivery.

**3****. KEY RESULT AREAS**

**P****roject and programme delivery**

* Manage approximately three to five initiatives end to end, depending on size, complexity and risk.
* Lead initiatives from mobilisation and business-case approval through planning, delivery, implementation, handover and closure.
* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, milestones, critical paths, resource requirements and delivery schedules.
* Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, success measures and dependencies.
* Coordinate cross-functional workstreams and ensure actions are clearly owned and completed.
* Manage project risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, decisions, changes and actions.
* Establish appropriate project governance, meeting cadence, reporting and escalation routes.
* Ensure initiatives are delivered in accordance with the agreed PMO methodology and stage-gate requirements.
* Support the UK-based Project Manager on larger or more complex enterprise programmes by managing defined workstreams, plans and reporting.
* Lead projects that can be effectively managed across locations, including finance and procurement improvements, systems and data initiatives, automation and Shared Service Centre processes.

**Value and benefits realisation**

* Ensure each initiative has a clear baseline, target, benefit owner, delivery date and evidence requirements.
* Track financial and non-financial benefits through to implementation and handover to business as usual.
* Prepare monthly benefit evidence and calculations for validation by FP&A.
* Identify changes to the original value case and escalate any risk to benefits early.
* Support the transition of delivered initiatives into operational ownership with clear accountability for sustaining the benefits.

**PMO governance and portfolio support**

* Maintain accurate and timely information in the central portfolio tracker, initiative register, benefits log, RAID log and dependency tracker.
* Provide regular status updates in accordance with the PMO reporting calendar.
* Prepare concise project updates, decision papers, governance packs and Steering Committee materials.
* Support portfolio stage gates, project health checks and governance reviews.
* Identify cross-functional dependencies, resource constraints and emerging delivery risks.
* Work with the PMO team to improve project reporting, governance standards, templates and ways of working.

**Stakeholder and change management**

* Build effective working relationships with stakeholders across the UK, Europe, APAC and other international locations.
* Work closely with Business Process Managers, who act as the primary project leads for their respective P&Ls or functions.
* Support Business Process Owners in making timely decisions and removing delivery barriers.
* Engage Champions for Change to support local communication, implementation and adoption.
* Promote transparency and early escalation of risks, blockers and changes to plan.
* Facilitate workshops, planning sessions, progress reviews and decision meetings.
* Operate as a constructive challenger, maintaining delivery momentum while ensuring risks and dependencies are understood.

**4****. KNOWLEDGE, TRAINING, EXPERIENCE & SKILLS REQUIRED**

  

**Essential Experience**

* 3+ years proven experience managing business change, transformation, continuous improvement, technology, finance, procurement, data or operational projects.
* Working knowledge of project management methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall and hybrid approaches, with the ability to apply them pragmatically.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate project teams across locations, time zones and cultures.
* Strong project planning, risk and dependency management, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Practical experience maintaining RAID logs, facilitating governance forums and stage gates, and managing scope and change control.
* Experience defining and tracking project outcomes, benefits or performance improvements.
* A recognised project management qualification, such as PMP or APM, is an advantage.

**Desirable experience**

* Experience in distribution, manufacturing, supply chain, finance or procurement.
* Experience delivering ERP or systems implementations, automation, data initiatives or process transformation.
* Familiarity with Continuous Improvement methods such as Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, process mapping or root-cause analysis.
* Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions or post-acquisition integration.

**Skills and behaviours**

* Highly organised, with strong planning, prioritisation and follow-through.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Confident engaging with senior stakeholders, project teams and operational colleagues.
* Collaborative and constructive, with the confidence to challenge respectfully.
* Commercially aware, with a focus on measurable business value and outcomes.

title: Project Manager (Civil)
description:
We are looking for a highly experienced and result-oriented **Project manager( Civil ) – Project Management Consultancy (PMC)** to take complete responsibility for our industrial PMC operations.

The selected candidate will be responsible for setting up PMC processes, managing multiple industrial construction projects, deploying and supervising site teams, monitoring project budgets and schedules, ensuring quality compliance, managing contractor performance and maintaining client relationships.

This is a leadership role requiring strong technical knowledge, commercial understanding and hands-on experience in industrial construction management.

Key Responsibilities

**1. PMC Division Development & Operations**

* Establish and manage the complete PMC division.
* Develop standardized procedures, checklists, reporting formats and project management systems.
* Recruit, train, deploy and supervise Project Managers, Site Engineers, QA/QC Engineers, Planning Engineers and other project personnel.
* Manage multiple industrial construction projects across different locations.
* Establish performance monitoring systems for site teams and contractors.

**2. Project Planning & Execution**

* Lead projects from preconstruction planning through execution, commissioning and handover.
* Prepare and review project schedules, construction sequences and execution strategies.
* Monitor civil, RCC, PEB, industrial flooring, external development, infrastructure and MEP works.
* Identify project delays, construction challenges and technical risks.
* Coordinate corrective actions and recovery schedules.

**3. Quality Assurance & Technical Supervision**

* Establish project-specific Quality Assurance and Quality Control systems.
* Supervise inspections, testing procedures, contractor quality plans and workmanship standards.
* Monitor compliance with approved drawings, specifications, relevant IS codes and project requirements.
* Review NCRs, inspection reports, testing records and corrective action closure.
* Coordinate technical clarifications with design consultants.

**4. Project Cost & Commercial Management**

* Monitor project budgets, cash flow and cost-to-complete forecasts.
* Review contractor measurements, running account bills and variation claims.
* Assist clients in tendering, procurement and contractor evaluation.
* Monitor contractor performance against contractual obligations.
* Identify and recommend cost optimization opportunities.

* Act as a senior-level point of contact for industrial clients.
* Conduct project review meetings with clients, consultants and contractors.
* Lead technical and commercial coordination meetings.
* Resolve execution-related issues through structured communication.
* Prepare management reports and present project performance to clients.

**6. Project Reporting & Digital Systems**

* Implement standardized Daily Progress Reports, Weekly Progress Reports and Monthly MIS.
* Establish centralized cloud-based project documentation and drawing control.
* Manage project trackers for schedules, procurement, RFIs, NCRs, safety observations and contractor billing.
* Implement digital site inspection and reporting processes.
* Maintain management dashboards covering time, cost, quality, risks and project progress.

**7. Business Development & Commercial Growth**

* Support management in identifying and developing new industrial PMC opportunities.
* Participate in client presentations, technical meetings and PMC proposal preparation.
* Prepare manpower deployment plans, PMC cost estimates and commercial proposals.
* Maintain customer relationships and identify repeat business opportunities.
* Manage division profitability, resource utilization and operational performance.

Required Qualifications

* B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering from a recognized institution.
* Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in construction or project management.
* At least 5 years in a senior project management or multi-project leadership role.
* Proven experience in industrial factories, manufacturing plants, PEB buildings, warehouses or industrial infrastructure projects.
* Experience managing projects with construction values of ₹20 crore or above.
* Strong knowledge of construction planning, execution, QA/QC, billing, procurement and contract administration.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Project or Primavera P6, AutoCAD, MS Excel and digital project management tools.
* Strong communication, leadership, reporting and negotiation abilities.
* Willingness to travel to industrial project sites across India.

Preferred Qualifications

* PMP certification or postgraduate qualification in Construction / Project Management.
* Prior experience working with a reputed PMC or engineering consultancy organization.
* Experience establishing a new PMC division or leading regional PMC operations.
* Knowledge of PEB construction, industrial flooring, fire protection and MEP coordination.
* Familiarity with Power BI, Zoho Projects, Autodesk Construction Cloud or similar project management platforms.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary engineering and construction teams.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated based on:

* Timely delivery of projects against approved baseline schedules.
* Effective cost control and contractor performance.
* Quality compliance and timely closure of project issues.
* Client satisfaction and repeat business.
* Project team productivity and manpower utilization.
* Accuracy and timeliness of management reporting.
* PMC division revenue, profitability and growth.

Pay: From ₹500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

title: Project Manager
description:
* Project Manager

Altera Digital Health is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented **Project Manager** to join our Service Delivery Management (SDM) team. This is an exciting opportunity for an internal candidate who is passionate about client success, operational excellence, and driving measurable business outcomes. The Project Manager will serve as a key liaison between our clients and internal teams, ensuring the highest standards of service delivery while contributing to the company's growth and profitability.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Client Relationship & Service Delivery Management**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned client accounts, building trusted, long-term relationships
* Manage and monitor contracted service delivery to ensure all commitments are met
* Achieve and maintain a **95% client retention rate** by proactively addressing client needs and concerns

**Project & Task Management**

* Oversee end-to-end project delivery, ensuring **100% on-time delivery** against agreed deadlines
* Track and manage all work against the client's Statement of Work (SOW)
* Professionally manage scope creep by guiding clients through the formal **change request process**
* Ensure all assigned Client Success Initiatives are fully implemented with success criteria met and signed off by stakeholders
* Review and update the **Weekly Project Summary Report** , tracking monthly hours utilized by task and team

**Financial & Budget Management**

* Manage monthly budget submissions and forecasting through the **Clarity portal** , including cost plan creation, reconciliation of forecasted vs. actual units, and submission for approval
* Review and approve team timesheets weekly, handling discrepancies promptly
* Monitor contracted growth metrics monthly and coordinate overage invoicing as needed
* Review monthly EBITA and financial files, updating the Monthly Ops Tracker before the 20th of each month

**SLA & Compliance Management**

* Achieve **95% or higher monthly SLA/OLA adherence** across all assigned accounts
* Prepare, maintain, and update monthly SLA documentation and trackers
* Monitor SLA breaches, obtain remediation plans from responsible teams, and document findings
* Monitor major incidents for assigned clients, coordinating with GMS resources for testing and validation as needed

**Contract & Account Management**

* Maintain centralized, up-to-date contract documentation for all assigned accounts
* Track contract end dates and proactively coordinate extensions with AVPs and AOEs before expiration
* Support AVPs in proposing additional services to clients during contract negotiations
* Develop and maintain RACI matrices and escalation matrices in accordance with contract requirements, reviewing and updating them regularly

**Business Development & Growth**

* Actively identify **1-2 upsell and cross-sell opportunities** per cycle by listening for client challenges during service delivery interactions and escalating leads to the appropriate sales or account management channels
* Contribute toward a **15% increase in referenceable accounts** by delivering exceptional client experiences

**Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Deliver **1-2 AI projects** with measurable, quantifiable impact (e.g., minimum 10% reduction in time spent on specific tasks)
* Identify and implement process improvements derived from customer feedback each quarter
* Pursue and complete **project management certification and relevant training** to enhance professional skills

**Required Qualifications**

* Proven experience in project management, service delivery, or a client-facing operations role
* Strong understanding of contract management, SLA/OLA frameworks, and financial tracking
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously with a high degree of organization
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust at all stakeholder levels
* Proficiency in project management tools and reporting platforms
* Experience with timesheet management and budget forecasting processes

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Project Management certification (PMP, CAPM, or equivalent) or active pursuit of certification

**Key Competencies**

* **Business Acumen** – Understands the financial drivers of the business and makes decisions that support revenue, cost efficiency, and EBITA goals
* **Customer Focus** – Consistently places the client experience at the center of all decisions and actions
* **Managing & Measuring Work** – Sets clear goals, tracks progress rigorously, and holds self and others accountable to outcomes
* **Process Management** – Identifies inefficiencies and implements structured improvements
* **Strategic Agility** – Anticipates future opportunities and adapts approach to meet evolving client and business needs
* **Innovation Management** – Embraces new technologies and approaches to drive continuous improvement

title: Regional Project Development Manager for Reciprocating Compressors
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**

We are seeking a Compressor Regional Project Development Manager (RPDM) for Reciprocating Compressors with a background in reciprocating compressors and proven understanding of driven/driver equipment and related auxiliary systems. This role is part of our dynamic regional service Modernization and Upgrades team in Asia Pacific.

Within the Asia Pacific region, we are supporting customers from the Oil & Gas, chemical and industrial sectors. You will be working closely with the regional Client Manager/mechanical & controls RPDM and be responsible for the technical solution as well as the techno-commercial proposal for developed compressor upgrade solutions.

This highly networked role requires the ability to work under pressure and meet ambitious deadlines, along with strong people management.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Actively and methodically explore the market to generate new leads and opportunities.
* Qualify opportunities for compressor upgrades, working with client managers to develop prospects and secure orders.
* Collaborate with the Controls Project Development Managers, CM, Service Centers to bring value propositions and navigate complex environments.
* Lead client communication such as technical presentations on rotating machinery M&U solutions and Siemens Energy's value propositions.
* Establish and maintain relationships with technical key decision-makers and influencers within client organizations, developing new client relationships through active engagement.
* Provide technical product training for regional teams, representatives, agents, and clients as required.
* Meet M&U targets and earning objectives, ensuring a clean handover to execution team.

* Develop regional technical and commercial proposals in alignment with customer requirements, defining the commercial according to organization’s policies and rules (Price, payment term, T&C’s etc)

* Prepare and issue Request for Quotations to the relevant major sub-suppliers in support of Siemens Energy bundled “extended scope" solutions) e.g. for site scans, cable laying, foundations, etc.)
* Work closely with various departments within the organization to collect the necessary information for preparing quotations for extended scope projects (such as site execution, repair center activities, installation, commissioning, and performance testing).
* Conduct site surveys, including preparation, execution, data collection, risk assessment, and report generation, for designated compressor upgrade projects to identify potential execution risks and establish a sequence of activities for execution.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in mechanical or equivalent experience in Engineering with demonstrated ability in rotating machinery in the energy industries, with extensive knowledge in rotating machinery (compressors).
* Minimum 6 years’ experience in reciprocating compressor field service, technical sales, proposals,commissioning Engineer or related work experience.
* Understanding of customer focused equipment and related auxiliary system control upgrade needs, with the ability to inform the factory about upgrade requirements and explain technical solutions to clients.
* Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams across organizational and international boundaries, with a strong and confident presence in front of Siemens Energy and client personnel.
* Self-motivated with high energy drive and business sense, with a good understanding of driven/driver rotating equipment design and thermodynamic principles.
* Experience with Siemens Energy’s rotating machinery products is preferable, along with an understanding of competition's products and offerings.
* Willingness to travel when needed, with the ability to present and discuss technical solutions effectively via Microsoft Teams.

**About the Team**

Our **Transformation of Industry** division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. Candidates want to learn about the divisions they will be joining–the structure, how it works together, and the role it plays in driving Siemens Energy’s mission forward.

**Who is Siemens Energy?**

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than 98,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we’re also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy *https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo*

**Our Commitment to Diversity**

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

**Rewards/Benefits**

* All employees are automatically covered under the Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy. – As a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. Accordingly, each employee is empowered to decide on the best Possible net income out of the same fixed individual base pay on a monthly basis.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
**Introduction:**  
Our goal at Pivotree is to help accelerate the future of frictionless commerce. We will help lead this change over the next decade because we believe a future where technology is embedded intimately into all aspects of our everyday lives can benefit everyone and will shape the interactions with the brands we love. We will help shape the future of frictionless commerce by working together with some of the best brands in the world and some of the best people in the industry to leverage converging technologies that will make it possible to accelerate frictionless commerce faster than ever.
  
  
Pivotree provides services focused on the design, implementation, management, and maintenance of complex ecommerce solutions for large enterprises. We provide the technical skills necessary to enable the effective use of technologies combined with the business context to leverage a solution to solve our clients' business challenges. We strive to fill the gaps in available technology with our own IP to reduce the barriers to adoption.
  
  
We enable inclusive, immersive and highly personalized experiences for our clients and their customers. We build our products with a view to productizing and scaling technology to lower the costs and reduce the risks of implementing and managing our integrated solutions. Each of our solutions starts with reliable and reputable e-commerce and MDM platforms, which run on enterprise grade infrastructure that are customized to meet a variety of client needs, situations, and budgets. Over the next 10 years we will add new categories and capabilities that will define frictionless commerce ecosystems.
  
  
This is a journey of technology acceleration combined with consumer readiness and adoption. We are looking for people capable of adapting relentlessly to the rapidly evolving world around us.
  
  
ABOUT
  
Pivotree is an AI-first company using cutting edge models from Gemini, Claude, CoWork and others. We use AI to automate and augment our workflows, develop new products, and find new ways of doing business. All employees use AI every day in their work and as part of teams continuously improving how we deliver.
  
As Senior Project Manager at Pivotree, you own end-to-end delivery for complex client engagements, managing scope, schedule, budget, and quality with independence. You lead Lead Project Managers assigned to individual workstreams. You bring strong stakeholder management and risk discipline to every project, and you use AI-assisted tools to accelerate status reporting and risk analysis while maintaining the judgment that keeps projects genuinely on track.
  
  
RESPONSIBILITIES
  
**Own end-to-end delivery for assigned client projects:** scope, schedule, budget, resourcing, and quality.
  
Lead Project Managers assigned to individual workstreams; ensure alignment and consistent governance.
  
Define and maintain project plans, RAID logs, and governance structures appropriate to project complexity.
  
Apply AI-assisted analytics to track schedule variance and resourcing risk; validate all AI-generated risk flags with project management judgment before acting.
  
Lead project status meetings and steering committee updates; communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly to stakeholders.
  
Use AI writing assistance to accelerate status reports and steering committee materials; review and validate all AI-generated content before distribution.
  
**Manage project financials:** budget tracking, forecasting, and margin performance for assigned engagements.
  
**Own risk and issue management:** proactively identify risks and drive mitigation before they impact delivery.
  
Partner with Business Analysts, Architects, and engineering teams to ensure delivery stays aligned to scope and quality standards.
  
Manage client relationships day-to-day, building trust through transparent communication and consistent delivery.
  
Mentor Portfolio Coordinators and Project Managers on delivery discipline and AI tool usage.
  
  
WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE
  
**Analysis:** Identifies project risks and interdependencies before they become delivery issues. Uses AI-assisted analytics to accelerate risk identification, but applies project judgment before acting.
  
**Customer Orientation:** Manages the project around the client's real business outcomes, not just the contracted scope.
  
**Decisiveness:** Makes clear decisions on scope trade-offs and resourcing without unnecessary delay.
  
**Organizing Work:** Governs a project with clear milestones, dependencies, and reporting cadences.
  
**Working with Others:** Builds trust with client stakeholders and cross-functional delivery teams.
  
**Developing Others:** Mentors Portfolio Coordinators and Project Managers on delivery discipline and AI tool usage.
  
**Initiative:** Identifies project risks and process improvements proactively; brings proposals to delivery leadership.
  
**AI-First Mindset:** Uses AI tools to accelerate risk analysis, status reporting, and steering committee materials. Validates every AI-generated artefact with project management judgment before it reaches clients.
  
  
SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES
  
7 to 10 years of project management experience delivering complex technology engagements.
  
Deep expertise in project governance, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
  
Strong financial acumen; experienced managing project budgets and margin outcomes.
  
Uses AI-assisted analytics and writing tools to accelerate reporting; validates all AI-generated content before client delivery.
  
  
TECHNICAL SKILLS
  
**Project management tools:** expert in Jira, MS Project, Smartsheet, or equivalent.
  
**AI-assisted project analytics:** uses AI tools for risk pattern detection and schedule variance identification; validates all outputs before acting.
  
PMI-CAPM or PMO-PMP or Prince 2 Certification, PMO-ACP or CSM or SAFE certification and any AI related certifications will be of added advantage
  
**Financial management:** proficient in project budget tracking and margin analysis.
  
**Executive communication:** skilled in producing steering committee materials and status reports.
  
  
Pivotree is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace.

description:

We specialize in delivering innovative solutions and exceptional services to meet the diverse needs of our clients. With a strong commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, we strive to exceed expectations and drive success in every project we undertake.

title: Project Director/Manager - IFRS 9 Credit Risk Modelling
description:
**Key responsibility areas:**

A. Engagement delivery and project leadership

Independently lead and manage consulting engagements with leading banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, insurance companies, and corporates across credit risk modelling, credit policy, regulatory capital, IFRS 9, and model risk management.

Own end-to-end delivery: scoping, project planning, resourcing, risk identification, mitigation, stakeholder coordination, and sign-off.

Lead client conversations on methodology, assumptions, model design, policy interpretation, regulatory expectations, and business impact.

Drive day-to-day execution of assigned client projects and produce regular status reporting for management on progress, challenges, and key milestones.

Manage audit, internal review, and regulator interactions related to models, credit policy, capital computation, ECL, and provisioning.

**B. Credit risk modelling and scorecards**

Lead development, review, and redevelopment of credit scorecards across the customer lifecycle: application, behavioural, collection, and bureau scorecards.

Lead development and review of credit rating and scoring models, including PD, LGD, and EAD models for retail and wholesale portfolios.

Own the full model development lifecycle: data preparation, treatment of missing values and outliers, WOE / IV analysis, variable selection, segmentation, model building (logistic regression, decision trees, gradient boosting, and other ML techniques), scaling, cut-off setting, and calibration.

Define and implement model monitoring frameworks: PSI, CSI, Gini / AUC, KS, lift, vintage and stability analysis, and trigger-based redevelopment.

Support credit strategy design, including approval / rejection / limit assignment strategies and risk-based pricing inputs. Produce clear, defensible model documentation and validation-ready model development reports.

**C. Credit risk policy, framework, and regulatory capital**

Review, design, and draft credit risk policies covering credit appraisal, underwriting, delegation of authority, collateral management, credit monitoring, EWS, restructuring, NPA / IRAC classification, provisioning, and write-off.

Assess policy effectiveness against regulatory requirements and internal risk appetite, and recommend enhancements.

Lead credit RWA computation under Standardised and IRB (F-IRB / A-IRB) approaches. Support capital adequacy (CRAR), capital conservation buffer, leverage ratio, ICAAP, and stress testing exercises.

Build and review stress testing and scenario analysis frameworks for credit risk, including portfolio-level impact assessment.

Interpret and apply RBI, Basel III / IV, and Middle East regulatory expectations on credit risk, capital, and provisioning.

**D. Portfolio analytics**

Lead portfolio analytics covering vintage analysis, roll-rate and migration matrix, delinquency and bucket movement, concentration risk, and portfolio ECL.

Build collections and recovery analytics, including recovery rate modelling and prepayment behaviour analysis.

Develop portfolio dashboards and MIS for risk committees, boards, and regulators.

Identify emerging risk trends and recommend corrective actions at portfolio level.

**E. IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 impairment**

Lead IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109 impairment workstreams covering staging, SICR assessment, ECL computation, and enhancement of ECL and provisioning approaches.

Design and review macro-economic scenario design, satellite models, and forward-looking overlay adjustments.

Support IFRS 9 transition and implementation, including parallel run, impact assessment, and disclosure requirements.

Align IFRS 9 ECL with credit policy, provisioning policy, and regulatory capital frameworks.

**F. Model risk management**

Lead model validation and independent review: conceptual soundness, data quality, methodology review, back-testing, benchmarking, sensitivity analysis, and outcome analysis.

Design and strengthen model risk management frameworks, including model governance, model inventory, model tiering, validation standards, and ongoing monitoring.

Define model risk appetite, model risk reporting, and escalation protocols.

Support regulatory and audit reviews on model risk management practices.

**G. Practice, people, and business (Project Director emphasis)**

Lead and be responsible for team mentoring, project management, and client delivery.

Own project revenue, margin, and resource utilization for assigned engagements.

Generate business from existing clients and support pre-sales, proposals, and solutioning for new clients.

Build and scale the credit risk consulting practice, including hiring, capability building, and reusable methodologies, scorecard templates, and accelerators.

Represent Acies in client leadership forums and industry discussions on credit risk, IFRS 9, capital, and model risk.

**Highlight of the engagement opportunity**

**Nature of role: Full time**

Number of years of experience expected: Project Manager: 8–13 years, including at least 5 years hands-on in credit risk modelling, credit analytics, credit policy, or regulatory capital. Project Director: 13–20 years, including at least 7 years in the above, with proven ownership of delivery, revenue, and client relationships. o Candidates without direct credit risk modelling / analytics experience will not be shortlisted, regardless of general risk consulting pedigree.

**Areas of past experience preferred / mandatory:**

**Credit risk modelling and scorecards:** application, behavioural, collection, and bureau scorecards; credit rating and scoring models; PD / LGD / EAD models; scorecard development lifecycle including data preparation, WOE / IV analysis, logistic regression and machine learning models, cut-off setting, calibration, validation, monitoring, and redevelopment.

**Credit risk policy and framework:** credit policy, underwriting and credit appraisal, delegation of authority, credit monitoring, early warning signals (EWS), restructuring, NPA / IRAC classification, provisioning, and write-off policy.

**Regulatory capital and Basel:** credit RWA computation, Standardised and IRB (F-IRB / A-IRB) approaches, capital adequacy (CRAR), capital conservation buffer, leverage ratio, ICAAP, and stress testing.

**Portfolio analytics:** vintage analysis, roll-rate and migration matrix, delinquency analysis, concentration risk, portfolio ECL, collections and recovery analytics.

**IFRS 9 / Ind AS 109:** impairment model design, staging and SICR logic, ECL computation, macro-economic scenario design, and disclosures.

**Model risk management:** model validation, model governance, model inventory, back testing, benchmarking, sensitivity and outcome analysis, and ongoing monitoring.

**Regulatory frameworks:** RBI guidelines on credit risk, ECL, IRAC, and provisioning; Basel III / IV; Middle East regulatory context (CBUAE, SAMA, CBB, QCB, CBO, CBK / CMA Kuwait) preferred. o Consulting or in-house risk analytics experience with banks, NBFCs, insurers, or corporates.

**Educational qualification expected:** Graduate / Postgraduate Additional qualifications / certifications required: None Preferable additional certifications: CA / FRM / Actuarial / CQF / PRM / CFA

**Preferred geography of previous work experience:** India / Europe / APAC / US / Middle East

**Language requirements:** Ability to write and speak fluently in English

**Application experience preferable:** MS Excel, VBA, Python, R, SAS, SQL

Pay: ₹2,000,000.00 - ₹5,000,000.00 per year

title: Lead Technical Program Manager
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Lead Technical Program ManagerAn AI‑First Technical Program Manager who organizes and accelerates delivery across agent‑amplified pods, using the written specification as the single source of truth and DORA/Core4 metrics as the primary delivery signal. Operates as a connective role in a shared pool — reaching into every pod to keep the program's coordination, risk, and dependency view current without orchestrating day‑to‑day — while preserving every SOX/PCI control gate. Manifest definitions, release integration, scope, and dependencies are tracked with data so all outputs are production‑ready at launch.  
  
Responsibilities  
  
Organizes and accelerates related technology projects across multiple pods, aligning dependent organizations; identifies and removes blockers and always finds the path forward.  
Charts the pod‑to‑pod relay (which pod builds each Epic stage), aggregates cross‑Big‑Rock risks and dependencies into a single view, and drives execution through the monthly Epic cycle anchored to the user guides.  
Serves as the source of truth for status; generates the Monthly Technical Review (MTR), RAID Log, and DORA rollup directly from the session record using M365 Copilot, so the ledger stays current without hand‑keeping.  
Measurably improves, streamlines, and eliminates excess process and ceremony — naming the reader of every artifact before it is kept and retiring legacy ceremonies deliberately.  
Keeps abreast of the evolving AI‑engineering landscape; understands the practical read of what AI can and cannot do — that AI amplifies engineering judgment and leaves that judgment with the human — and asks the right questions to evaluate scalability, latency, security, performance, and data integrity.  
Works with ambiguity and limited guidance, comfortable with the indeterminism of agent‑driven delivery, kept honest by the monthly user guides and real‑customer feedback.  
Transforms raw thoughts into clear, concise communication and can communicate with confidence 3+ levels up; fluent in prompt patterns and agent‑session discipline to produce review‑ready output on the first pass.  
Understands the needs of engineers and BizOps/SRE teams, including the verification tax and the build‑and‑review, follow‑the‑sun pairing that manages it.  
Reviews metrics and proactively seeks improved data and mechanisms for visibility, keeping the program aligned to objectives while preserving all control gates — AIFE removes coordination overhead, not controls.  
Plays an active role in mentoring, recruiting, and growing agent fluency and the Expert‑Generalist skill ladder across pods.  
  
Experiences  
  
Anticipate bottlenecks and factor in contingency for unplanned delays, including transition risk from Scrum to the pod model.  
Define success metrics where they are missing, defaulting to the four DORA/Core4 metrics: Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, and Failed Deployment Recovery Time.  
Recognize discordant views and resolve them through constructive dialog; act as the program's anti‑confirmation‑bias check.  
Continuously assess development processes, test plans, and operations to improve concurrent delivery, including tests‑first/spec‑driven parallelism and same‑session documentation currency.  
Streamline or eliminate excess process wherever the same efforts or issues repeat year‑over‑year.  
Expert with scrum delivery and its evolution into the AIFE monthly Epic and pod‑relay operating model, including the shift from story points to spec‑projected slices.  
  
AI‑First Tooling & Skills  
  
M365 Copilot fluency: Excel (RAID Log, dependency matrix, DORA dashboards), Word (MTR generation, handoff notes), Loop/OneNote (async session logs).  
Spec‑as‑ledger discipline: treat the specification as reviewed engineering work; let agents project epic/feature/story records on demand rather than hand‑slicing or pointing.  
Relay and shared‑pool operating model: chart pod relays, manage follow‑the‑sun handoffs, and steer by feedback at Epic boundaries.  
Agent accountability and audit‑safety: ensure a named human directs and reviews every agent output, with session logs and control‑role sign‑offs keeping who‑built/who‑approved auditable.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
